newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 21.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China expands local currency interbank market by admitting city cooperative banks, extending interbank short-term money trading, which had previously been restricted to the provincial level, to major cities.
- Premium income of the People's Insurance (Group) Co, China's top insurance company, increased by a year-on-year 40 percent to 42.8 billion yuan in the first half of 1997.
- Figures issued by the State Statistical Bureau indicate China has entered a new period of economic development characterised by high economic growth rate and low inflation.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's retail sales value increased by a year-on-year 16.5 percent to 65.1 billion yuan in the first half of 1997.
- Shanghai's service sector is now responsible for 48 percent of the city's total employment, an increase of 20 percentage points against the start of 1990s.
